messages:
elaine: Heads-up — legal signed off on the v1 -> v2 deprecation notice. Plan is to publish Tues 09:00 UTC. Need docs PRs, redirect map, and sample-snippet fixes by EOD Mon.
ben: ack. I'll run an audit of all examples that call /v1/invoke and list hardcoded model ids.
ashok: @ben can you also check embedding examples for dimension changes? We had a couple models changed from 1536 -> 1024 in the alias swap.
ben: yep. will output a csv with path + affected snippet lines.
elaine: main risks: (1) broken JS/TS snippets that use positional params, (2) embed dim mismatch, (3) lingering links to the old /v1/models endpoint.
sam: for SDKs we should ship a tiny aliasing shim in the TS and Py examples to reduce client breakage. idea: fallback to alias map if model id not found.
elaine: agreed. keep it explicit in the migration guide, but we shouldn't recommend long-term use of shims. add a code example.
sam: snippet draft:```js
// quick alias shim
const aliasMap = new Map([['open-embed-legacy','open-embed-1024-v2']]);
const model = aliasMap.get(request.model) || request.model;
await client.invoke({ model, input: request.input });
```
ben: nice. I'll make a small PR to replace inline examples in docs/reference and docs/examples.
docs-bot: PR opened: redwood/docs#4321 by @ben — "replace v1 invoke snippets + alias shim examples" (CI: pending) :github: 
ashok: pinging infra - some private deployments have pinned weights. We need to document rollback steps if the alias swap introduces regressions. Add a "how to rollback to v1-model" note.
elaine: good call. add an explicit rollback snippet and a checklist for Dedicated customers (who might need model pinning).
niraj: QA note — add a small smoke test harness that runs the canonical snippet set against both v1 and v2 for the affected models. Should run in CI nightly during the rollout window.
ben: created smoke-test script in docs/ci/smoke-migrate.sh and added a job in the docs CI. PR updated. docs-bot: CI passed for the snippet PR. :white_check_mark: 
docs-bot: redirect map updated draft: /models/open-embed-legacy -> open-embed-1024-v2; /models/old-chat -> chat-medium-v2. See redwood/internal/redirects.md (WIP).
elaine: thanks — two final asks before publish: (1) QA sign-off from @niraj, (2) small blurb in the "breaking changes" email copy for customers using model pins.
niraj: I'm running the smoke tests now, will post results in 30m. If any failure, mark the PR for hotfix.
sam: also flagged a small SDK behaviour change: previously client.invoke accepted a `messages` array and `content` interchangeably in some language SDKs. We documented positional args; need to normalize docs to the new explicit payload shape.
elaine: callout added to the migration guide: "normalize to explicit payload fields (input/messages/content) — do not rely on positional shorthand."
ben: PR #4321 merged to staging. I left TODOs in a few spots for product copy where we must not mention internal aliases.
elaine: great. @niraj any blockers?
niraj: smoke tests: 3/45 snippets failed — two embed dim mismatches (fixed in PR #4322), one streaming example timed out (increased timeout in docs CI). Rerunning.
docs-bot: PR #4322 opened by @ashok — "fix embed dims for sample apps" (CI: running).
ashok: fixed the two embed examples and updated the migration note to show checking vector lengths in the console.
elaine: OK — once CI green, I'll schedule the deprecation notice for Tue 09:00 UTC and trigger redirect publish. Postmortem: please capture any customer-facing regressions under the "deprecation-rollout" tag.
ben: documenting owners + followups in the PR description.
irs: (typo)
elaine: :laughing: small quirk. thanks team — this felt much smoother than previous sunsets.
ben: final: created the docs release PR that bundles migration guide, snippet fixes, redirect map. PR number: redwood/docs#4330.
elaine: perfect. I'll merge at 08:00 UTC on Tue and coordinate the email send. Thanks everyone.
